display.purpose: Hero titles, section headings, quotes, roadmap numbers.

body.purpose: Long-form prose, descriptions, form copy. Max ~65–100ch.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrow above section headings; accent color.

motion.name: ease-fluid
motion.purpose: Transform and panel transitions; exponential ease-out.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA on light backgrounds (CV download, form submit).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(62% 0.19 250); color: oklch(98% 0.005 265); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px oklch(48% 0.16 252 / 0.35); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 340ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 340ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), box-shadow 340ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate3d(0, -3px, 0); background: oklch(48% 0.16 252); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(62% 0.19 250); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); transition-duration: 120ms; }

components.name: Primary Button on Dark
components.description: Primary CTA inside hero dark block.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(96% 0.01 265); color: oklch(16% 0.05 265); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 340ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 340ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary-dark:hover { transform: translate3d(0, -3px, 0); background: oklch(78% 0.12 250); color: oklch(16% 0.05 265); } .ds-btn-primary-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(78% 0.12 250); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary-dark:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(99% 0.006 90 / 0.8); color: oklch(20% 0.045 265); border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.02 265); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 340ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 340ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translate3d(0, -3px, 0); border-color: oklch(62% 0.19 250); color: oklch(62% 0.19 250); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(62% 0.19 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Label
components.css: .ds-section-label { margin: 0; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(62% 0.19 250); }

components.name: Skill Tag
components.description: Interactive skill chip in skill groups.
components.css: .ds-skill-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.02 265); background: oklch(99% 0.006 90); color: oklch(48% 0.025 265); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 340ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-skill-tag:hover { transform: translate3d(0, -2px, 0); border-color: oklch(62% 0.19 250 / 0.4); color: oklch(20% 0.045 265); } .ds-skill-tag:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(99% 0.006 90), 0 0 0 4px oklch(62% 0.19 250 / 0.5); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Contact form input with focus lift.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; color: oklch(20% 0.045 265); background: oklch(99% 0.006 90); border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.02 265); border-radius: 0.5rem; outline: none; transition: transform 340ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 340ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-field:focus-visible { transform: translate3d(0, -2px, 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(62% 0.19 250 / 0.45); } .ds-field[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: oklch(78% 0.12 25); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(78% 0.12 25 / 0.4); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(48% 0.025 265); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 340ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), color 220ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: oklch(20% 0.045 265); transform: translate3d(0, -1px, 0); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(62% 0.19 250); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.css: .ds-surface-panel { position: relative; padding: 1.5rem; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.02 265); background: oklch(99% 0.006 90); box-shadow: none; transition: box-shadow 340ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-surface-panel::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; border-radius: inherit; background: oklch(62% 0.19 250); opacity: 0.55; } .ds-surface-panel:hover { box-shadow: 0 12px 28px oklch(20% 0.04 265 / 0.06); } .ds-surface-panel__title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(20% 0.045 265); } .ds-surface-panel__summary { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(48% 0.025 265); }

components.css: .ds-timeline-entry { display: grid; gap: 1rem; list-style: none; } @media (min-width: 768px) { .ds-timeline-entry { grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 2rem; align-items: start; } } .ds-timeline-entry__logo { width: 7.5rem; height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: oklch(88% 0.02 265 / 0.35); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-timeline-entry__panel { padding: 1.5rem 2rem; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.02 265); background: oklch(99% 0.006 90); } .ds-timeline-entry__period { margin: 0; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(62% 0.19 250); } .ds-timeline-entry__title { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(20% 0.045 265); } .ds-timeline-entry__role { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(20% 0.045 265); } .ds-timeline-entry__place { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(62% 0.02 265); } .ds-timeline-entry__summary { margin: 1rem 0 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.625; color: oklch(48% 0.025 265); } .ds-timeline-entry__list { margin: 1.25rem 0 0; padding: 1rem 0 0; border-top: 1px solid oklch(88% 0.02 265 / 0.8); list-style: none; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: oklch(48% 0.025 265); } .ds-timeline-entry__list li { display: flex; gap: 0.625rem; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-timeline-entry__dot { display: inline-block; width: 4px; height: 4px; margin-top: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(62% 0.19 250); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(62% 0.19 250 / 0.15); color: oklch(48% 0.16 252); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Un portfolio che si presenta come un ritratto professionale: metà presenza umana, metà prova tecnica. La pagina non urla competenza con badge e metriche; apre con calore (hero scuro, foto, citazioni) e lascia che tipografia, spaziatura e accessibilità dimostrino il craft.
keyCharacteristics: Palette calda con blocchi hero profondi e accent blu-viola controllato
Pulsanti pill, ombre solo a stato

rules.name: The Restrained Accent Rule
rules.body: L'accent copre CTA, label di sezione, focus e pochi punti di scansione. Non tintare intere sezioni.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Mai nero o bianco puri. Neutri sempre leggermente tintati verso 265 o 85.

rules.name: The Display-Body Split Rule
rules.body: Bricolage solo per titoli, label e citazioni; Hanken per tutto ciò che si legge a lungo.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Interaction Rule
rules.body: Card e pannelli senza ombra a riposo. Ombre compaiono su hover, scroll o elementi sollevati.

dos: Do usare OKLCH per tutti i token colore; tintare neutri verso 265/85
Do mantenere touch target minimo 44px su controlli interattivi
Do guidare lo scan recruiter verso CV, skills e contatto
donts: Don't usare template SaaS generici: hero metric, card grid identiche, gradient text, glassmorphism decorativo
Don't eccedere con animazioni o effetti flashy
Don't cadere nel corporate freddo o clone LinkedIn
Don't usare border-left/right spessi colorati come accento
